args.body: Advance WELFARE-ELIGIBLE-CASE-OPERATOR-CARD from the actual committed inventory and latest receipts. If the card exists, read it and close the mission under a valid lease when its acceptance criteria are met. If a required check is missing, fill only that gap using the pinned CAD 49 terms and independent lot-source correction. The operator should be able to decide from the card whether an eligible case can proceed. Require redacted evidence of the current official notice's actual inclusion in the case, and direct the operator to hold fulfillment when that evidence is missing. Keep case eligibility, reply delivery, administrative order acceptance and founder-confirmed settlement distinct. Save and read the artifact before closure with a lesson. Use the authorized private cycle for any real case and preserve the November 20 checkpoint, December 4 17:00 UTC retirement and independent publication gate.

description: Prioritize the live welfare offer, which has documented CAD 49 terms and an administrative Interac route. Offline rehearsals support preparation, and five unclassified feedback sources leave eligible demand unknown. The next step is to verify whether the operator card already exists and make it usable for the next eligible case. Fulfillment depends on evidence that the current official notice reached the private case. Order acceptance and settlement require separate administrative evidence. Reassess demand at the November 20 checkpoint using then-current permitted evidence, and preserve the December 4 17:00 UTC retirement. Verified available funds and verified revenue are both CAD 0.
